segments.title:
A red week
everywhere
segments.say: What a week. Markets fell around the world. The S&P 500 lost more than 8 percent in five days. Here's your Friday close across five markets.

segments.title: This week's damage
segments.sub: Friday 20 Nov close vs Friday 13 Nov
segments.say: In New York, the NYSE Composite fell 7.6 percent this week. In Johannesburg, the All Share index lost almost 7 percent. London's FTSE 100 dropped 5.1.

segments.title: ZSE All Share
segments.say: Zimbabwe held up far better. The ZSE All Share was down about one and a half percent by Thursday. As I found out, Friday's final index figure wasn't published yet when I checked.

segments.title: Friday's movers
segments.sub: ZSE and VFEX, Friday 20 Nov session
segments.say: On Friday, Seed Co jumped 16 percent on the VFEX. NMBZ and Rainbow Tourism each rose 14 on the ZSE. Zimplow fell 12, and Simbisa 9.
But why did the world fall?

segments.title: What we know

cards.sub: led by tech and chip stocks

segments.say: Tech and chip stocks led the fall, but in the sources I checked there was no single confirmed cause. Zimbabwe's market moved on its own, because it has different drivers and a different currency.
